pitch_routes.genre: News-led documentary / true crime (Hulu, Disney+, ABC)
pitch_routes.route: Disney Terms of Use s.7.A (covers Disney, ABC, ESPN, FX, National Geographic and other Disney brands): 'Our long-standing company policy does not allow us to accept or consider unsolicited creative ideas.' briefs.title: Robin Roberts unit to expand slate in pop culture, news and crime
briefs.summary: Katie Conway promoted to EP of Robin Roberts' unscripted development and production unit, to expand its slate in pop culture, news and crime, focusing on stories at the centre of the cultural conversation.
